requirement.description: The VHttpSrv class in test utilities doesn't initialize the ptn_cc attribute that is required by the httpcli module. This attribute is needed for validating control characters in HTTP headers and query parameters.
requirement.contract: Add the ptn_cc attribute initialization to the VHttpSrv.__init__ method. The attribute should be a compiled regex pattern for control character validation, similar to how it's done in the main HttpSrv class in httpsrv.py. Specifically, it should be set to re.compile(r"[\x00-\x1f]") to match control characters.
